title: ID0418771-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP/R4170001742] hardware issue
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
Dear Support Team, I would like to report a new issue observed on one of our charging cables. One of the pins appears to be slightly coming out of its socket, which may indicate a defect or damage. Could you please advise on the following points: 1. Is this a known issue, or has it been reported before? 2. Could this potentially be linked to other recent issues we’ve experienced (e.g., abnormal fan behavior, sensor alerts, etc.)? 3. What are the recommended next steps (e.g., replacement, further inspection)? Pictures can be provided if needed.
